rule.description: A complete re-declaration of the repository's supported-language set (the canonical list exported by scripts/locales.ts) living outside the module that owns it: an array literal, object-literal key set, or switch case-test set whose locale-key set is exactly equal to the full supported set. Each such site is one more place a conceptual language-roster change would have to touch.

checks.description: Detect a non-owner module that re-declares the complete supported-language set as a literal (array elements, object keys, or switch case tests), so that a change to the language roster would require an edit in that module too.
checks.detected_relation: module -> private complete copy of the supported-language registry owned by scripts/locales.ts
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The supported-language roster is conceptual knowledge with one designated owner; each private complete enumeration in a publishing stage is one of the many small coordinated edits a single conceptual roster change would scatter across, which is the shotgun-surgery relation assigned to this case.

matches.evidence: Module-scope table localeFileInfixes: Record<string,string> with keys exactly {en, zh-CN, ja, ko, pt-BR}, consumed by localizedInfix()/publishedReadmeName() to build every published localized README name; the module no longer derives names from the shared locale module.

Module-scope constant routeLocales: SupportedLocale[] = ['en', 'zh-CN', 'ja', 'ko', 'pt-BR'] replacing the previous import of the roster; both redirect loops and the per-quiz emission loop iterate it.

Function-local table variationInfixes with keys exactly {en, zh-CN, ja, ko, pt-BR}; the sibling-file lookup now iterates Object.keys(variationInfixes) and interpolates the per-language infix instead of consulting the shared roster.

Module-scope table readmeLocaleInfixes: Record<string,string> with keys exactly {en, zh-CN, ja, ko, pt-BR} plus local helper readmeFileName(); the available-language list and both README regeneration loops iterate Object.keys(readmeLocaleInfixes).
Function-local array renderableLocales = ['en', 'zh-CN', 'ja', 'ko', 'pt-BR'] gating which language's content may be rendered, falling back to the default language otherwise.

resolveFilePath dispatches over the language codes in a switch whose case-test set is exactly {en, zh-CN, ja, ko, pt-BR} (with a default arm for other codes), re-deciding the localized path shape locally.

Function-local table readmeInfixes inside translateQuiz with keys exactly {en, zh-CN, ja, ko, pt-BR}; the translated README destination is spelled inline from it instead of through the shared path resolution.

Module-scope constant playgroundLocales = ['en', 'zh-CN', 'ja', 'ko', 'pt-BR'] as SupportedLocale[]; both the CLI argument match and the interactive selection menu read from it instead of the shared roster.

excluded: scripts/locales.ts is the owner module and is exempt by design: its supportedLocales declaration is the canonical one this rule measures all other sites against, so it must never be reported.
utils/*.ts and scripts/**/*.ts sites that mention a proper subset of the supported languages, or a single language code, do not re-declare the complete registry and are not matches.

Literal sets that mention language-like codes for a different purpose and never match the full supported set exactly (e.g. shorthand locale-mapping data inside scripts/locales.ts itself) are outside the rule.
